name: Thief of Sanity
oracle_text:
Flying
Whenever this creature deals combat damage to a player, look at the top three cards of that player's library, exile one of them face down, then put the rest into their graveyard. You may cast that card for as long as it remains exiled, and mana of any type can be spent to cast that spell.
blocked_sentences: Whenever this creature deals combat damage to a player, look at the top three cards of that player's library, exile one of them face down, then put the rest into their graveyard. You may cast that card for as long as it remains exiled, and mana of any type can be spent to cast that spell.

needs.what: look_at_top's pick out of another player's library must be made by the effect's controller when the card says "you": `op_look_at_top` passes the library owner's seat as `chooser` to `pick_from_pool` (and to `ask_objects` for `destinations` steps), which overrides the selector's own `chooser` clause, so for `player` naming an opponent the OPPONENT chooses which card is exiled. Needs look_at_top to honour an explicit `objects.chooser` (e.g. `"chooser": "controller"`) over the library owner
needs.why_existing_wont_do: `playable_cast_only` (shipped) now says the cast-only permission exactly, and `deals_combat_damage_to_player` with `look_at_top` `player: {"binding": "event_player"}`, `amount: 3`, `destination: "exile"`, `face_down`, `rest_to: "graveyard"`, `playable: "while_exiled"` and `any_type` say everything else; but `objects: {"count": 1, "chooser": "controller"}` loads and is ignored because the op's chooser argument wins in `selectors.pick_from_pool`, so the damaged/targeted opponent would pick the worst of the cards for you -- a much weaker card than printed
